theme: An open day, with Croatia one week out.
greeting: The calendar is nearly bare, Dan — just the NACD New England call at midday. The real weight is off-screen: you fly to Croatia in a week and a handful of bookings are still open.

needsAttention.title: Send your bio to Ellen and Deb
needsAttention.detail: Your own note flags the NACD New England follow-up. Get your email and board bio to Ellen Richstone and Deb Rosenthal now that today's call has happened.

needsAttention.title: Croatia bookings still open
needsAttention.detail: Two P1 items are past due against a hard wall at your Sept 8 departure: the last Dubrovnik night in Cavtat on Sept 19, and written confirmation that checked bags are actually on the ticket.

needsAttention.title: St Pete nights, Sept 20-22
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sept 20 but the girls aren't picked up until the 22nd. The two-night gap before the Orlando villa still needs a room.

schedule.title: NACD New England call

flagged.title: Conor Kehoe wants a call
flagged.detail: A Zoom invite about PRI sustainability and stewardship, sent this morning. Worth a reply to lock a time.

inbox.noise: The rest is promotional -- Doublelist and Care.com reminders.

acts.line: A clear runway before noon, with nothing on the calendar until midday.
A single hour holds the day: the NACD New England Zoom at noon.
The rest opens up, and with the girls in residence it bends toward home.
